picks.title: Midjourney: Report Finds AI Model Worst For Flouting Hollywood IP
picks.excerpt: Disney accused Midjourney of being a "bottomless pit of plagiarism" in a lawsuit last year. More than 18 months on, there remains cause for concern.
picks.rationale: A new report ranking image models on Hollywood IP infringement. Anyone generating key art or previs with Midjourney now has a concrete rights risk to weigh.

picks.title: AI Can Cut Film Budgets by Up to 40%, Says 'The Outlaws' Director Kang Yoon-sung, as Netflix Reveals Use on 300 Titles: 'A Human Touch Is Absolutely Essential'
picks.excerpt: At Busan, Netflix's Lee Sung-gyun, director Kang Yoon-sung and Weta FX's Kimball Thurston debated how far AI should reach into film production.
picks.rationale: Hard numbers: Netflix says it has used AI on 300 titles, and a director claims budget cuts of up to 40%. The speakers and panel differ from the published Rustad (10-11) and Mousavi/VIEW (10-14) Netflix cards.

picks.title: Peacock App Launches 'Your Bravoverse,' Featuring a Personalized TikTok-Style Video Feed Hosted by AI-Generated Andy Cohen
picks.excerpt: Peacock is bowing a personalized stream of clips from Bravo shows, inspired by apps like TikTok, brought to you by a chatty AI avatar of Andy Cohen.
picks.rationale: A concrete product launch: a major streamer ships a personalized clip feed hosted by a licensed AI avatar of its talent. AI is the feature itself, and it shows where streamers are taking AI hosts and personalized presentation.

picks.title: Busan's Asian Contents & Film Market evolves with added focus on AI and microdramas
picks.excerpt: ACFM runs October 10-13 at Busan's Bexco exhibition centre.
picks.rationale: Market-level view: Asia's biggest content market is restructuring around AI (dedicated AI programming and showcases). Adds a third outlet and gives the big-picture view behind the individual Busan AI panels already covered.

alternates.title: My Screen Life: Taiwanese producer Patrick Mao Huang on spotting new talent and embracing AI
alternates.excerpt: The Taiwanese film producer talk spotting up-and-coming filmmakers, learning those unwritten industry rules and the transformational impact of AI on storytelling.
alternates.rationale: Fresh but weak: a career-profile interview where AI is one theme among several. Use only if another pick is swapped out.
